text: しかたないから　おばちゃんの　おうえんで　げんきだしてね！

structure.jp: おばちゃんの　おうえんで

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'so' or 'because': what comes before is the reason. しかたないから = 'it can't be helped, so'

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows the thing you use to get something done, like 'with' or 'by'. おばちゃんの　おうえんで = 'with auntie's cheering'

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form on its own at the end is a casual 'please do', the short version of てください. げんきだしてね = 'cheer up, okay?'
